question: Choose the correct passive form of: The cadets completed the obstacle course.
option_a: The obstacle course is completed by the cadets.
option_b: The obstacle course was completing by the cadets.
option_c: The obstacle course has been completing by the cadets.
option_d: The obstacle course was completed by the cadets.
explanation: The simple past active sentence becomes simple past passive with was or were plus past participle. Completed is the past participle of complete.

question: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
option_a: The PAF pilots flew the reconnaissance mission.
option_b: The Navy deployed two new frigates last month.
option_c: The parade was reviewed by the Chief of Army Staff.
option_d: The cadets marched past the saluting dais.
explanation: A passive sentence uses a form of be plus a past participle, and the doer may appear after by. Was reviewed shows passive structure.

question: Change to the active voice: The new recruits were trained by experienced instructors.
option_a: Experienced instructors are training the new recruits.
option_b: Experienced instructors trained the new recruits.
option_c: Experienced instructors have been trained the new recruits.
option_d: The new recruits trained experienced instructors.
explanation: The passive were trained matches simple past, so the active subject instructors takes the simple past verb trained.

question: Fill in the blank: The annual inspection _____ by the commanding officer tomorrow.
explanation: Tomorrow needs future tense, and inspection is the receiver of the action, so the passive form will be conducted is correct.

question: Choose the correct passive form: They must submit their medical reports before reporting.
option_a: Their medical reports must submit before reporting.
option_b: Their medical reports must submitting before reporting.
option_c: Their medical reports must have submit before reporting.
option_d: Their medical reports must be submitted before reporting.
explanation: After a modal verb, passive voice uses be plus past participle. Submitted is the past participle of submit.

question: The written test _____ already by most candidates in the batch.
explanation: Already with present perfect passive needs has been plus past participle. Taken shows the test was finished.

question: Choose the best passive equivalent of: Submit your documents before the deadline.
option_a: Your documents should submit before the deadline.
option_b: Your documents should be submitted before the deadline.
option_c: Your documents should submitted before the deadline.
option_d: Submit your documents should be before the deadline.
explanation: An imperative order becomes passive with should be plus past participle. Submitted correctly shifts focus to the documents.

question: Convert to passive: The selection board is interviewing the candidates right now.
option_a: The candidates are being interviewed by the selection board.
option_b: The candidates were being interviewed by the selection board.
option_c: The candidates are interviewing by the selection board.
option_d: The candidates have been interviewed by the selection board.
explanation: Present continuous active becomes are or is being plus past participle. Right now matches are being interviewed.

question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
option_a: The national flag was hoist by the cadet at dawn.
option_b: The national flag is hoist by the cadet at dawn.
option_c: The national flag was hoisted by the cadet at dawn.
option_d: The national flag was being hoist by the cadet at dawn.
explanation: Hoisted is the correct past participle of hoist. Was hoisted forms a proper simple past passive sentence.

question: Choose the correct passive form of: The instructor gave the cadets their posting orders.
option_a: Their posting orders were given the cadets by the instructor.
option_b: The instructor was given their posting orders to the cadets.
option_c: The cadets were given by the instructor their posting orders.
option_d: The cadets were given their posting orders by the instructor.
explanation: When the indirect object becomes the subject, the sentence reads subject plus were given plus direct object plus by agent.

question: Change to passive: They had finished the briefing before the General arrived.
option_a: The briefing had been finished before the General arrived.
option_b: The briefing had finished before the General arrived.
option_c: The briefing was been finished before the General arrived.
option_d: The briefing has been finished before the General arrived.
explanation: Past perfect active had finished becomes had been finished in the passive. The time clause before the General arrived stays unchanged.

question: By next week, all short-listed applications _____ by the Navy selection cell.
explanation: By next week points to future perfect, and applications receive the action, so will have been processed is correct.
